production.note: US model years 2018-2021. Start: Jeep's press kit of 12 April 2017 says 'the 2018 Grand Cherokee Trackhawk will arrive in Jeep showrooms in the fourth quarter of 2017'. Last: Jeep's 2021 Grand Cherokee brochure lists the Trackhawk ('6.2L Supercharged V8 engine, 707 hp and 645 lb-ft of torque') (jeep-grand-cherokee-2021-brochure); the 2022 Grand Cherokee brochure lists only Summit, Summit Reserve, Limited and Trailhawk and no supercharged engine (jeep-grand-cherokee-2022-brochure). No opened Jeep page says in so many words that 2021 was the last model year.

drivetrain.note: Transfer case 'MP 3015C', 'Single-speed, electronic proportioning', 'Operating Mode Full-time four-wheel drive' (Jeep Quadra-Trac). Full-time with no low range, so AWD under the data guide's rule.

transmission.note: 'TorqueFlite 8HP95 Automatic, Eight-Speed Overdrive', the only transmission.

powerHp.note: Jeep 2018 Trackhawk specification sheet. Quote: "Power (SAE J2723) 707 hp (527 kW) @ 6,000 rpm". Torque 645 lb-ft. The press kit (jeep-trackhawk-2018-presskit) says 'supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 engine delivering 707 horsepower and 645 lb.-ft. of torque', and the 2021 brochure (jeep-grand-cherokee-2021-brochure) still gives 707 hp. The rating is the same for 2021, the reference year.

weightLb.note: Car and Driver's specifications section for the 2021 Trackhawk (the maker's figures, not a road-test measurement), read by the project owner on 3 October 2026 (the site blocks the research tools): curb weight 5,356 lb. Weight-order step 2 (major magazine specification panel). Jeep's own 2018 sheet gives 5,363 lb, but under the heading 'WEIGHTS (Estimates)', which the data guide does not accept (jeep-trackhawk-2018-specs); see discrepancies.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's 2021 specifications give 5,356 lb; Jeep's 2018 sheet gives 5,363 lb in a table headed 'WEIGHTS (Estimates)'.
discrepancies.resolution: Jeep's figure is labelled an estimate, so the 2021 Car and Driver figure is used and 2021 is the reference year.
